independent_computation.note: The leaf carries no numeric value, so the correct independent derivation is not arithmetic over a wiki row but a determinism/jurisdiction argument over the golden map. It is stated as a proof and each premise is quoted from in-jurisdiction sources below.

formalization.definition: Let V = G(E, D) be the vector of golden leaf values, where E is the engine source under src/ together with the harness scripts/golden_snapshot.py, and D is the cached wiki data under data/. The coupled-golden (E-series corpus) is a second evaluation of the same map with the same two arguments.
formalization.premise_1_inputs: G takes exactly two inputs, E and D. docs/math-foundations.md fixes the input contract as the engine under src/calculator/ plus the League Wiki cache (data/champions.json, data/items.json) and game files; data/README.md fixes data/ as 'the single source the app reads', written only by src/calculator/data_updater.py and read only through src/calculator/data_fetcher.py. Nothing outside src/, data/ and scripts/ is an argument to G.
formalization.premise_2_determinism: G is deterministic on the golden path. docs/math-foundations.md Section 0: 'The engine runs with deterministic=True in every scoring path (optimizer, BIS, golden corpus)'. The one stochastic carve-out named in the document — '/api/calculate alone still rolls natural crits' — is explicitly outside the golden corpus path, so no residual randomness can move a golden leaf. Under determinism, equal inputs force bit-identical outputs; there is no seed, sample or ordering freedom left to differ.
formalization.premise_3_hypothesis: The scenario stipulates delta-E = empty and delta-D = empty: no src/, data/ or scripts/ file is touched anywhere in the slice group.
formalization.derivation: delta-V = G(E, D) - G(E, D) = 0 for every leaf, by premises 1-3. Therefore the set of moved golden leaves is empty, and the same argument applied to the second evaluation makes the coupled-golden diff set empty as well.
formalization.conclusion: The correct golden leaf for this slice group is the empty set, whose canonical rendering is '(none)', with old and new both '(none)' — i.e. a no-op leaf, correctly reported.

independent_computation.consistency_check_on_the_declared_popula: The three commits each declared 'Expected qualifying occurrences: 0' against a population enumerated pre-edit from committed artifacts. An occurrence count of 0 entails an empty edit set over that population; an empty edit set over a population that in any case excludes src/, data/ and scripts/ cannot perturb either argument of G. The two independent statements (0 occurrences; no engine/data/harness file touched) agree, and neither can be falsified from within the data/ jurisdiction — I found no numeric row under data/ that the leaf names, because the leaf names none.
independent_computation.what_would_falsify_this: A golden or coupled-golden leaf showing any non-'(none)' movement for this slice group would contradict premise 2 or premise 3: with the engine, harness and cache all byte-identical, a moved number could only come from nondeterminism on the golden path, which docs/math-foundations.md excludes by construction.
